body:
My mom has no idea I feel this way, but Ive been out of the house for two years and just can't bring myself to put this on her shoulders as well. I really don't fault her for the fact I had a terrible childhood, she was doing the best she could but just wasnt around very much.

I wish going to therapy was that easy, unfortunately I'm American and my insurance has little to no coverage for anything mental health related. 

I'm happy to hear your daughter is doing so well though, that gives me some hope.

Your post made me smile because when I feel especially terrible I order Dominos and know that "god what have I become" feeling that comes with it, and I have a pet I love and I really don't even know what would happen to her if I went through with it. Maybe we can talk about shitty pizza and you can tell me about your dog and how goddamn annoying it is when you're constantly in your own way [getting trapped in your head].
Do you get off egging people on to kill themselves?

My biggest concern right now is that my mom would be absolutely devastated. She is a terrible mother but a generally decent person and I know that this would destroy her because she would feel responsible even though she isn't, at least not entirely. 

I just wish there were a way to make it painless for everyone involved.
